body:
Thanks @redox.
That's what we decided to omit (https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/1616#issuecomment-263539378). It'd require maintaining those services APIs in instantsearch.js and would become pain in future.
Because of that we settled on exposing only `pushFunction` which the widget will run in the right time with right data.

We will publish a guide how to integrate few services (like [currently commented out in app.js](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/1626/files#diff-1765d0005076c116a75098c1162e835bR34)).

But I don't understand what you mean by
> to avoid writing again and again the same code?

I don't see issue with repeating code.
